row.title: A queue item must not close on a check that passes because the item is held
row.body: Q-LESSON-no-date-bombs had the done check lessons --check, which passes exactly while the item is held; the queue closed it as fixed on that pass and the same check turned main red. Each lesson item now closes only on lessons --probe <id>, which fails until a binding lands, and lessons --check refuses any other done check.

title: A queue item must not close on a check that passes because the item is held
